_doc: Allowlist for direct @anthropic-ai/sdk imports. Enforced by scripts/check-no-direct-anthropic.ts. See docs/orientation/maia-sovereign-runtime-intelligence-audit.md for context.
_invariant: MAIA is a layered intelligence architecture in which substrate inference is one conditional manifestation pathway, not the cognition center. New direct SDK imports bypass sovereignRouter and re-introduce drift. Additions here must be deliberate and pass PR review.

approved.description: Canonical provider-adapter layer. The ONLY files that should newly import @anthropic-ai/sdk are SovereignRouter-backed adapters. New additions here are load-bearing architectural decisions and require explicit PR review.

operational.description: Non-cognitive endpoints that legitimately need direct SDK access (health checks, authentication probes, billing telemetry). Cognitive surfaces do NOT belong here.

grandfathered.description: Legacy cognitive surfaces that bypass sovereignRouter. Each one is an intelligence layer that currently delegates its reasoning to substrate instead of executing its own logic. To be migrated per docs/orientation/maia-sovereign-runtime-intelligence-audit.md. New additions are strongly discouraged — they represent expansion of the drift this guard exists to prevent.
